top.line: How the summit's chasm made us zoom in to a £50 Sovereign Website, and why it is possible.
top.para: A startup in our own work.

in-short.line: No small first step at the stand; one product at £50; ownership as the advantage; layers underneath.

chasm.line: Visitors understood the agents and policies, and had nothing small to buy next.

zoom.line: From agentic teams to one thing: a website owned by the person it is for, £50 or €50 once.
zoom.para: The small cell; the teams behind it.

map.line: Of eleven platforms, only one says you can take your site away; many small firms have no site.

why.line: AgentiCCells, behaviour policies, signed decisions, PKI and the site factory make it possible.

data.line: PrompTugal's data went from 9 to 30 sources in five days, then was stopped on purpose until it moves.

limits.line: Nothing sold yet; the journey is an account; market figures from public pages; collection stopped for now.

sources.line: sovereignwebsite.ai, the strategy and decisions sites, pki.sgit.ai and the PrompTugal repositories.
